title: サトノ家として、ウマ娘として

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm walking by the academy gate one evening on a day off, when…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Satono hasn't come back yet?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: It doesn't look like it. Let's wait here a little longer.
choice_data_list: Has something happened to Satono Diamond?
Has something happened to Satono Diamond?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're her trainer, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Palmer saw Satono leave this morning. Apparently, she was heading off to her family's company.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Surprised by what I'm hearing, I ask Mejiro Ryan for more details. It seems Satono Diamond went to one of the Satono family offices.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: She apparently said she'd be back by evening, but nobody's seen her yet, so we're starting to worry…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I ask them to leave this matter to me and then give Satono Diamond a call.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hello? Trainer?
choice_data_list: Are you still at your family's office?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her how that Mejiro Ryan and the others are worried about her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, I didn't mean to worry everyone. I'm okay, though. I've just about wrapped up everything.
choice_data_list: It's pretty late, so I'll come pick you up.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? Okay, then I'll tell the front desk to let you through.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I arrive at the building Satono Diamond directs me to, and head to the floor she's on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't see her, so I start looking around the area.

text_block_list.name: Satono Group Employee
text_block_list.text: What are we going to do about the charity race?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: First things first, we have to decide on a time and place.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'll speak to Mother and get an idea of how to proceed before our meeting next week.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best to attract as many people to the event as possible. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The employee thanks Satono Diamond and leaves.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer! You're here!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Our group is currently planning a charity race as part of our philanthropic initiatives.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: As both a member of the Satono family and an Umamusume, I want to contribute in some way, even if there's only so much I can do personally.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she speaks, her expression appears more dignified than usual. I can tell she feels a strong sense of duty in her role here.
choice_data_list: Spoken like a true member of the Satono family.
Spoken like a true member of the Satono family.
Are you planning to compete as well?
Are you planning to compete as well?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she speaks, her expression appears more dignified than usual. I can tell she feels a strong sense of duty in her role here.
choice_data_list: Spoken like a true member of the Satono family.
Spoken like a true member of the Satono family.
Are you planning to compete as well?
Are you planning to compete as well?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Why, thank you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I will stand at the head of the family one day, so until that time comes, I think it would be wise to broaden my horizons.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Plus, I'm always filled with the motivation to put my best foot forward when I'm working on behalf of the Satono family!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she smiles, it's apparent from her expression how much pride she has in representing her family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, welcome back! You look rather perky for someone who just finished a long day of work.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: As a Satono, it's my duty to be able to handle these matters. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, it's just like Palmer said! You really are like McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Do you really mean that?! I'd love to hear more!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I am indeed.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: As I mentioned before, I am both a member of the Satono family and an athlete.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I may still be inexperienced, but I hope to one day make meaningful contributions to my family's work and the world of racing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond has her sights set not just on the present, but further down the road as well. Her eyes beam with the light of a promising future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, welcome back. How was work?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond tells her two friends about the charity race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My, that sounds very interesting indeed! I'd love to take part in the race too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You're more than welcome to! We'd love to have everyone from the Mejiro family join!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ And since I'm competing, I'll of course be aiming to finish first.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Of course. It wouldn't be a race without some good competition! I'll be giving it my all too. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you're really like two peas in a pod. Sounds like this'll be interesting…
